descriptionFull: The common grasshopper warbler ( Locustella naevia ) is a species of Old World warbler in the grass warbler genus Locustella . It breeds across much of temperate Europe and western Asia. It is migratory, wintering in north and west Africa. The genus name Locustella is from Latin and is a diminutive of locusta , "grasshopper".
